summary: Master donor rules, award controls, and audit readiness across USAID, EU, FCDO, and UN funding. Book practical training.
lede: Donor compliance is the disciplined management of award terms, documentation, and internal controls throughout a grant’s lifecycle. For grants, finance, procurement, and programme professionals, this course addresses the practical work of maintaining traceable award files and reliable reports. It covers cost allowability, procurement documentation, budget variance tracking, subaward oversight, and audit-ready records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage donor awards, compliance reviews, budgets, procurement files, and reporting packs across international funding streams.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of project finance, grant administration, procurement files, and donor reporting cycles. Familiarity with basic budgeting, expense coding, and internal controls is expected. This course does not require coding or programming. Advanced concepts are taught at operational application level, with conceptual exposure to donor portfolio strategy and compliance benchmarking where needed.
